citation.authors: Quinn AA, Myrans H, Gleadow RM

cited_by.title: Plantain, yam and cassava: blood sugar and safety

record.population: Cassava products sold in Melbourne, Australia
record.design: Laboratory cyanide measurement of ready-to-eat, frozen grated and frozen whole root products
record.finding: Cyanide was highest in ready-to-eat cassava chips (mean 48.4 ppm), higher in imported products (95.9 ppm) than Australian-made (1.0 ppm), against Australia's limit of 10 ppm. Frozen products were significantly reduced by processing as directed on the packet.
record.note: Product testing in Australia; no people. The 10 ppm limit is Australian, not a UK rule.
